mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 2 THEN -o.total_amount WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN -o.total_amount WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 2 THEN o.total_amount ELSE o.total_amount END ), 0) FROM t_rob_order_operate_log l INNER JOIN t_rob_order o ON o.id = l.order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS n) split ON l.operate_type = 3 WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT l.order_id AS order_id, MAX(l.create_time) AS latest_event_time, MAX(l.id) AS latest_log_id FROM t_rob_order_operate_log l INNER JOIN t_rob_order o ON o.id = l.order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY l.order_id ORDER BY latest_event_time DESC, latest_log_id DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN o.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN o.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN o.profit_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_profit_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN o.profit_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_profit_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN o.recommend_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_recommend_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN o.recommend_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_recommend_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN o.self_buy_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_self_buy_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN o.self_buy_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_self_buy_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN o.self_buy_bonus_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_self_buy_bonus_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN o.self_buy_bonus_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_self_buy_bonus_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN o.self_buy_coupon_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_self_buy_coupon_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN o.self_buy_coupon_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_self_buy_coupon_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN l.receipt_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_receipt_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN l.receipt_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_receipt_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN l.payment_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_payment_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN l.payment_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_payment_amount FROM t_rob_order_operate_log l INNER JOIN t_rob_order o ON o.id = l.order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 WHERE 1 = 1
